real_environment: a 1961 Yale basement psychology laboratory with a brushed-steel thirty-lever voltage generator box
environment_props: brushed-steel thirty-lever voltage generator box labeled 15V to 450V
wooden laboratory desk and dividing partition wall
grey lab technician clipboard and four-quadrant answer box

cast.subject: volunteer teacher in a 1960s rolled-up white dress shirt
others: experimenter in a knee-length grey lab technician coat
learner strapped into a wooden chair behind the partition wall

wardrobe.teacher: 1960s white button-down dress shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows and loosened dark tie
wardrobe.experimenter: knee-length grey laboratory technician coat over a white collared shirt and narrow black tie
wardrobe.learner: 1960s white dress shirt and vest with leather straps across the forearms

must_have_scenes.title: The 30-lever shock generator: 'Please continue'
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: A man in a 1960s dress shirt sitting in front of the 30-lever 15V-to-450V XXX shock generator box while a man in a grey lab coat stands behind him saying 'Please continue'.

key_visual.description: the teacher mannequin presses a lever on the thirty-switch shock generator while the grey-coated experimenter stands behind him saying please continue

must_have_scenes.title: Learner pounding on the dividing wall at 150V and 300V, then silence
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Fists pounding through the laboratory wall followed by eerie silence while the volunteer still flips switches to 450 volts.

must_have_scenes.title: Touch-proximity variation: forcing the learner's hand onto the metal plate
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Having to physically hold the learner's hand down on the metal contact plate makes seven out of ten people refuse.

must_have_scenes.title: Defiance: refusing the bare order and dissenting peers walking out
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: When given a bare order or when two peer teachers refuse to flip the switches, thirty-six of forty men push their chairs back and stop.

setup.camera: Wide establishing shot tracking forward toward the brushed-steel switch console
setup.environment: In a bright 1961 Yale basement laboratory divided by a partition wall, a strapped learner mannequin sits in the next room while a teacher mannequin in a rolled-up white shirt faces a thirty-lever voltage generator labeled fifteen to four hundred fifty volts
setup.action: The teacher presses a metallic toggle switch down as an experimenter mannequin in a grey coat taps a clipboard
setup.prop_change: A red indicator light flashes, the voltmeter needle jumps right, and relays buzz
setup.reaction: The teacher flinches and clutches his forehead with one trembling hand

symptom.camera: Medium cross-section shot tracking sideways across the dividing laboratory wall
symptom.environment: Inside the bisected 1961 Yale basement laboratory, the strapped learner mannequin sits behind the wooden partition wall beside the thirty-lever voltage generator desk
symptom.action: The learner pounds his fist against the dividing wall twice and slumps still, while the teacher mannequin in a white dress shirt pushes the final four-hundred-fifty-volt XXX toggle switch down
symptom.prop_change: The partition wall vibrates, the red pilot light flashes, and the voltmeter needle swings right
symptom.reaction: The teacher braces both elbows on the desk and buries his head in his hands

failure.camera: Medium tracking shot gliding sideways along a row of wooden seminar desks
failure.environment: In a bright 1961 Yale classroom, a chalkboard diagram shows the thirty-lever voltage generator box before fourteen student mannequins in tweed jackets
failure.action: A student mannequin shakes his head, scribbles a mark at the one percent line on a survey sheet, and slides the paper across the desk
failure.prop_change: The pen nib clicks against the desk and the stack of survey papers slides to the edge
failure.reaction: The students lean back in their wooden chairs and fold their arms confidently

crisis.camera: Close-up shot pushing in on the volunteer teacher's bare wrist beside the switch console
crisis.environment: At the 1961 Yale laboratory desk, two unfolded paper slips reading Teacher lie beside the thirty-lever voltage generator box
crisis.action: The experimenter mannequin in a grey lab coat straps a metal contact to the teacher mannequin's wrist and flips the third forty-five-volt toggle switch down
crisis.prop_change: The metallic toggle switch snaps down, the red pilot light flashes, and the wire twitches
crisis.reaction: The teacher jolts backward in his chair, yanks his forearm away, and rubs his stung wrist

pivot.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot pivoting from the grey-coated experimenter to the volunteer teacher at the console
pivot.environment: In the bright 1961 Yale basement laboratory, the teacher mannequin in a rolled-up white dress shirt sits before the thirty-lever voltage generator box
pivot.action: The experimenter mannequin thrusts his metal clipboard forward, and the teacher slams his palm flat on the desk and shoves his chair backward
pivot.prop_change: The wooden chair skids across the floor, the released toggle switch springs up, and the voltmeter needle drops to zero
pivot.reaction: The teacher stands up with squared shoulders and raises an open palm in refusal

step1.camera: Wide two-shot dollying laterally across the open laboratory room
step1.environment: In the 1961 Yale basement laboratory with the partition wall removed, the strapped learner mannequin sits in full view just feet from the thirty-lever voltage generator
step1.action: The learner jerks against the leather wrist straps right in front of the desk, and the teacher mannequin in a white shirt yanks his hand off the toggle switch
step1.prop_change: The leather straps rattle taut, the voltmeter needle swings to zero, and the red light flickers off
step1.reaction: The teacher recoils in his chair and drops both hands into his lap

step2.camera: Close-up shot tracking tightly across the metal contact plate on the laboratory table
step2.environment: In the 1961 Yale basement laboratory, the learner mannequin sits right beside the thirty-lever voltage generator box next to a wired steel contact plate
step2.action: The learner pulls his hand off the steel plate, and the teacher mannequin grabs the learner's forearm to press the palm down before recoiling
step2.prop_change: The steel contact plate slides across the tabletop, a small spark flashes, and the toggle switch clicks off
step2.reaction: The teacher steps backward from the table and holds both porcelain hands up in refusal

step3.camera: Wide shot pulling back across the three-chair generator desk
step3.environment: In the 1961 Yale basement laboratory, two peer teacher mannequins in white dress shirts sit beside the volunteer teacher mannequin before the thirty-lever voltage generator
step3.action: Both peer teachers slam their notebooks shut, push their wooden chairs back, and stand up, and the volunteer teacher pulls his hand off the switch
step3.prop_change: Three wooden chairs slide backward across the floor while the red indicator light snaps dark
step3.reaction: All three teachers stand shoulder to shoulder with folded arms as the experimenter lowers his clipboard

breakthrough.camera: Medium shot pushing in toward the tenth switch on the voltage console
breakthrough.environment: In a bright modern psychology room, a teacher mannequin in a button-down shirt sits before the thirty-lever voltage generator at the one-hundred-fifty-volt mark
breakthrough.action: The teacher presses the tenth toggle switch down, flinches as the wall vibrates, and reaches for the next switch before the researcher steps in and covers the panel
breakthrough.prop_change: The red indicator light flashes, the voltmeter needle jumps right, and the clipboard drops onto the desk
breakthrough.reaction: The teacher slumps back in his chair and wipes his forehead with his sleeve

conclusion.camera: Wide shot slowly pulling back and rising to an elevated angle over the laboratory
conclusion.environment: In the bright 1961 Yale basement laboratory, the thirty-lever voltage generator box sits silent on the wooden desk beside the grey-coated experimenter mannequin
conclusion.action: The volunteer teacher mannequin in a rolled-up white dress shirt pushes his chair back, stands up from the console, and walks toward the open door
conclusion.prop_change: The red pilot light clicks off, the voltmeter needle drops to zero, and the door swings open into bright daylight
conclusion.reaction: The teacher strides forward with upright posture while the experimenter lowers his clipboard
